title: Yara and the Cipher
author: Silas Nystrom
blurb: Lior Zhou, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the trial begins.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
